scope: Reviewed the Japanese article and all twelve translations for meaning, terminology, mathematical definitions and implications, code applicability, and links. Added an input-size polynomial bound on certificate length, a SAT/NP-completeness example, and the current unresolved status; removed an unsourced claim about what many researchers believe.
findings: Removed the duplicate future date and restored the original publication date, with lastmod set to the review date.
Defined NP with a certificate whose length is polynomially bounded by input size; explained why P is a subset of NP.
Added SAT as an NP-complete example and the conditional implication that polynomial-time SAT yields P=NP.
Stated that P vs. NP remains unsolved and did not present P≠NP as a proven result.
Added primary Clay Institute sources and MIT OpenCourseWare notes in all locales.
